programme.desc: El mundo que nos rodea contiene muchos sistemas complejos que funcionan perfectamente juntos. programme.title: Presentimientos (2026)
programme.desc: La relación de Julia y Félix, una joven pareja de clase media, atraviesa un momento delicado. Se les ocurre la idea de irse unos días de vacaciones a la playa para salvar su relación. Cuando llegan a su destino, empiezan a discutir, y Julia coge el coche y se va. Tras oír el violento estruendo de un accidente, se detiene y sale para ver qué ha pasado. Al volver al coche, descubre que le han robado el bolso. Por si fuera poco, no encuentra el camino de la urbanización. Empieza así el angustioso deambular de Julia y Félix buscándose mutuamente en un paraje desconocido.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Suzu está encantada con su nueva aplicación, que identifica y evalúa el peligro potencial de las especies animales. Pero el Equipo Astro es llamado a una misión en el África subsahariana, donde Dakarai y Akua están atrapados en un árbol con un león que se comporta de forma errática debajo. El Equipo Astro los rescata y, con el conocimiento felino de Astro Kitty, rastrean al león. Suzu y Astro se dan cuenta de que hay un grave problema con el suministro de agua de los leones: un río se ha secado. Cuando Suzu localiza un río alternativo, se siente satisfecha de sí misma, pero descubre, demasiado tarde, que está contaminado por los desechos de una antigua mina de oro. El Equipo Astro debe trabajar con Dakarai y Akua para darles un antídoto a los leones y asegurarse de que el río sea seguro para beber.

We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank: Part Two
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson

When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: To truly grasp the concept of forgiveness, we have to be willing to see past the person's mistakes. The benefit we get from being more forgiving isn't that other people are going to be more forgiving towards us, it's that it won't affect us when they aren't.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In this lesson, we'll discover the significance of holy relationships. After all, souls are brought together for the purpose of enlightenment.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Nesi sospecha que Omar la engaña con un hombre por mensajes. Karissa perdió a su bebé tras mudarse con Josh. Los detectores de mentiras revelarán la verdad.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: Mi hija es una madre inútil
programme.desc: Los nietos de Sabrina fueron retirados 3 veces por negligencia y abuso. Su padre los aleja de ella. Luego, Rose descubre quemaduras de 2º grado en su hijo. ¿Las causó intencionalmente su madrastra, Alecia?

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Kiki y Kat eran compañeras de trabajo que se enamoraron. ¡Pero ahora Kat dejará a Kiki por un hombre! Después, Cedric viene a decirle a su novia que quiere llevar su relación a otro nivel... y a otra persona.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: El regreso de los huéspedes del pasado Parte 2
programme.desc: Jaycee le demuestra a Brandy que nunca es correcto ser infiel y arruinar a una familia. Casi cree que su prometido podría aprender una lección de Kevin, un antiguo invitado. Además, concertamos una cita entre la espectadora Tamara y el invitado Nathan.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Alex, quien dejó a su novia mientras estaba embarazada, la quiere de vuelta; Ciarra enfrenta la ira de Trice por acostarse con su novio.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: La amiga y hermana de Antiatte deciden si aceptará la propuesta de matrimonio de su novio; dos mujeres luchan por el amor de una estrella porno; Britanny dice que algo anda mal en el comportamiento de su novio.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: ¡Es la batalla de los ex! Tony lucha para recuperar a su ex-amante. Richard le cuenta a su esposa que ha tenido un romance y ve a Lisa, su ex-amante, luchar por recuperarlo.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Emani dice que hará cualquier cosa para recuperar a su ex novio, pero su mejor amiga le dice por qué no debería hacerlo; el marido de Davita tiene una confesión que hacer; Shannon desafía a la otra mujer de su novio a un combate de lucha libre.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Un sospechoso de un suicidio se desliza en las sombras de la impunidas y envenena la vida de dos gemelas menores, cuyo destino final parece sellado por sus mismas manos. Un sistema judicial lento y desbordado permite que la tragedia se repita.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ricky Cardona relata el caso en el que un intento de robo terminó en devastación.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Angie Sandoval perdió a su perro Alejandro, robado en Suba. La indiferencia social ante el robo fue evidente. En Colombia, el maltrato animal aumentó un 41% en el último año. La senadora Andrea Padilla busca esclarecer la ley para proteger mejor a los animales.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Funza, Cundinamarca, más de 2000 personas fueron engañadas por una asociación que prometía viviendas. Desde estafas hasta terrenos inapropiados, el sueño de tener casa propia se convirtió en una amarga pesadilla de promesas rotas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En un país donde las motos son el corazón del transporte rural, tragedias silenciosas desgarran familias enteras. Cifras alarmantes reflejan la necesidad urgente de conciencia y firmeza en normas de tránsito.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Una joven llena de sueños cae desde un séptimo piso en circunstancias extrañas. Una relación rota, secretos oscuros y una noche fatídica se entrelazan, mientras una familia busca respuestas y la verdad parece cada vez más elusiva.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Leidy Johana García tuvo una hija con José Luis Mota, su primer novio, pero la relación terminó por problemas económicos. José Luis, incapaz de aceptar la separación de su hija, asesinó a golpes a Leidy en un ataque de ira. Fue capturado por la comunidad al intentar huir. Tras dos años y medio de juicio, fue condenado por homicidio simple a una pena mínima excarcelable y quedó en libertad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Danna Cervantes desapareció en diciembre de 2017 tras salir de clases en Sincelejo. Su cuñado, Crusto Díaz, la engañó para abusarla y asesinarla en venganza contra su hermana.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: La familia Peña, famosa por su negocio de papas y altruismo, enfrentó extorsión y amenazas. Milciades intentó proteger a Rubiela y su hija, pero la situación trágicamente terminó en un triple asesinato.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Luz Stella García fue asesinada por su esposo Luis Antonio Quilcue tras años de celos y violencia. Él alegó defensa propia y recibió una condena reducida de 5 años y 4 meses, pese a evidencia de premeditación.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: La muerte de Diana Marcela es el resultado de una historia de celos, pasion, traicion que destruyen a toda una familia. Tras las investigaciones de la fiscalía a causa del homicidio, se destapan secretos que sorprenden a la familia, vecinos y pareja de la víctima.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en la Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, dos hermanos desaparecieron cerca de la vereda Nuevo Mundo. Tras sospechar inicialmente de la madre, la investigación reveló que David Barbosa Arrieta, empleado de confianza del padre, había abusado y asesinado a los menores. Las pruebas recopiladas confirmaron su culpabilidad, y Barbosa fue condenado a 60 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Chinchiná, Caldas, en 2012, Angie, de 14 años, desapareció tras aceptar en secreto una cita con un hombre que le prometió un celular. Ocho días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en la vereda "La Pola". La verdad salió a la luz cuando Javier, un preso en Popayán, acusó a su propio hermano del asesinato de la menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Una familia campesina se muda a Cali buscando un mejor futuro para su hija Jaqueline, de 10 años. En 2012, la niña desaparece misteriosamente. Meses después, su cuerpo es hallado en un cañaduzal. Las investigaciones señalan a Óscar Eduardo Cadavid, esposo de su tía, como principal sospechoso. Capturado en 2013, fue condenado a 43 años de prisión por desaparición forzada.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Daniella Álvarez, ex señorita Colombia, perdió su pierna izquierda tras complicadas cirugías. Con valor, enfrenta terapias diarias y sueña con una fundación para ayudar a otros.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: El periodista Herbin Hoyos murió por COVID-19 a los 53 años. Secuestrado por las FARC durante 17 días, creó "Las Voces del Secuestro", programa radial que durante 24 años envió mensajes de esperanza a secuestrados, jugando un papel clave en rescates como la Operación Jaque. Ganó 84 premios de periodismo y dio 11.567 "abrazos de la libertad" a quienes ayudó a sobrevivir.

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: Mi hermana te engañó... ¡No eres el padre de su bebé!
programme.desc: ¡Shatoria le sigue diciendo a D'Eric que él no es el padre del hijo de su hermana Latasha! ¡Luego, el exnovio de CiCi, Angel, le niega el bebé porque su mejor amigo Ralphie lo dice! ¡Los resultados te dejarán sin palabras!

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: Si eres infiel con mi hermana ¡la boda se cancela!
programme.desc: Michelle sospecha que Dwayne usa un alias y engaña con su hermana Tiffany. Colleen, cansada de mentiras, quiere saber si él oculta una vida sexual secreta como “¡Gran Papá Russ!”.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the items featured are an African witch doctor's ceremonial stick, a school boys exercise book from 1745 and a Scandinavian drinking tankard.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the finds are a letter from Florence Nightingale, the racing silk of a famous jockey, a collection of old wedding photographs, and an Art Deco diamond brooch found in wartime London.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the finds are a machine gun from World War One, a papal portrait rescued from the bottom of a river and a set of rare maps recording the early settlement of America.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the treasures brought for valuation are an elegant grape holder made from silver, a cabinet of rare microscope slides and a ruby and diamond brooch.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Roadshow visits the Outer Hebrides. Amongst the items brought to light are some gruesome medical instruments and a table made from shipwreck salvage.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the Antiques Roadshow team are presented with an Art Deco cigarette case, a 'shock therapy machine', and an ornate pedestal that had been abandoned in a garage.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel marks the 200th anniversary of the Battle of Trafalgar. Among the finds are ornately decorated ostrich eggs and a box made out of debris taken from the vessel.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head to Abergavenny in Wales where a strange coincidence unites two Beatles collectors. Amongst the other items brought to light are exquisitley carved whalebone and a macabre pottery model.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the items viewed are a collection of pre-historic spear heads, an early American flag, a highly valuable silver tankard and a pair of spectacles worn by Napoleon.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visit Dartington Hall near Totnes in Devon to unearth more treasure. They examine a set of royal cufflinks, a letter from Admiral Nelson and a valuable collection of silver.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A return visit to Dartington finds Michael Aspel and the team with another busy day of finds. Objects under scrutiny include a French cabinet with royal connections.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Ever wondered what happens when the Antiques Roadshow rolls out of town? In this special edition, Michael Aspel traces what has happened to some of the star items from the show.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team are at Lichfield Cathedral in the Midlands. Amongst the items are a small statue thought to be from the tomb of Tutankhamun, an early Punch and Judy set and a sword pistol.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head for Wales where Michael Aspel and team unearth more intriguing finds including a bust of Dylan Thomas, an intricate book of early silhouettes, and a plate.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The experts return to Edinburgh. Amongst the items are an early Mickey Mouse mascot, a rare deco figurine and documents that once belonged to the bodyguard to Edward and Mrs. Simpson.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The experts converge on Normanby Hall where treasures include a marble bust and a pair of rare candlesticks won in a newspaper competition.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Inside the Pannier Market the team discover a cache of curiosities including an inmate's uniform from the early days of Dartmoor prison and a valuable plate bought for a song at a boot sale.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel digs up unscreened finds from recent Roadshows. Amongst the objects are a ring once owned by the Romanian Royal family, an elaborate bed and a bizarre collection of coffinalia.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team head east to Ipswich where they discover a Duke's chamber pot now used to drink champagne and one of the earliest record players.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team step back in time at the Beamish Open Air Museum. Amongst the items are a rare rapier sword allegedly smuggled out of Russia in the props box of the Bolshoi Ballet.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team enter Border country as the Roadshow visits Manderston. Amongst the items are pieces from Queen Victoria's household, a gruesome Man Trap and Lord Palmer's collection of biscuit tins.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Amongst the objects under scrutiny in Rochdale's magnificent town hall are a gold pencil gifted by King George IV, paint brushes used by LS Lowry and the diaries of a British hangman.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team visits the Royal Hospital in Chelsea. Amongst the items are a Roulette table built to outwit cheats, a collection of buttons worn by Charles Dickens and a gilded bee from a royal throne.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The team are at the seaside resort of Ventnor. Under scrutiny is a family portrait showing a Speaker of the House of Commons as a young boy and 75 Austin vehicles.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel introduces a selection of unscreened finds. Items include an Edward VIII Coronation souvenir that was hastily converted to an abdication mug and early fan mail for Elton John.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: The Roadshow team head for Lancaster. Amongst the items uncovered in the Town Hall are a valuable pair of clogs, a moving series of letters from Crimea, an anti-slavery ring and a rare tapestry.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.sub-title: Curar a mi hija con cuy; Falsas acusaciones

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Crossfit sex; El caso de Nerson
programme.desc: Por culpa del CrossFit quiere solo sexo violento, su esposo ya no aguanta, pide ayuda psicológica para ella o el divorcio. Rosa exige que Jinnette adopte a su hermana menor, no quiere criarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El difunto no está muerto; ¿A quién pertenece la niña?
programme.desc: Lorena queda viuda y se casa con Daniel, pero el difunto regresa y ella quiere que viva en la casa. Cambian a dos niñas por error, una muere y la otra sobrevive, las dos familias la reclaman.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sombrero para el miembro; Cerebro frito

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La última nalgada; Evidencia en teléfono
programme.desc: Alicia exige que su marido deje su práctica de masajes con nalgadas o se divorcia. Jessica demanda a su amiga Karla, porque le entregó a la policía un teléfono celular que la llevó a la cárcel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Padre sale de prisión; Éxtasis mortal
programme.desc: Después de años preso, este padre sale de la cárcel y exige la custodia de su hija. Lola quiere emanciparse, su padrastro practica la autoestrangulación en el sexo y así murió su madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Pasteles grotescos; Chica malcriada exige manutención
programme.desc: Francisco es repostero y prepara impactantes pasteles con imágenes eróticas y sexuales. A Mariana la echan de su casa por malcriada, ella demanda a sus padres, exige que ellos la mantengan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El ojo del amor; Enemas de cloro para autistas
programme.desc: Boris es tuerto y su único ojo es para Ana, ella lo amaba, pero él se volvió violento. Raúl pide la custodia de su hija con Isabel, quien quiere curar el autismo de la niña con enemas de cloro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Elizabeth exige un cambio en la póliza de su complejo residencial que respete el nudismo-cristianismo. Blanca pide una orden de desalojo y una de alejamiento para Pablo, pero él no piensa marcharse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo adoptivo padre de mi hijo; M. Broun abuso policíaco
programme.desc: Maritza adopta a Santiago, cuando crece se enamora de él y sale embarazada. Williams quiere impedir que su esposa mexicana entre a la academia de policía. El momento es muy conflictivo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hombre como objeto sexual; Santo cachón con un negro
programme.desc: Bárbara demanda a Estefany, porque se llevó de la casa el juguete sexual que compartían. Sebastián pide el divorcio, cree que su esposa lo engañó, tuvo gemelas, una es negra y la otra blanca.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Babalawo mexicano; Preso, viudo y casi papá
programme.desc: Hugo quiere las cenizas de su bebé para llevarlas a Cuba, es Babalawo y necesita recuperar su energía. David debe ir a la cárcel, pero antes, quiere darle a su cuñada la custodia de su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Trío pide examen de paternidad; Parto naturista
programme.desc: Dos hombres y una mujer tienen una relación y ella se embaraza, quieren saber quién tiene derechos sobre el bebé. Flor desea dar a luz de manera natural en el Amazonas, su esposo está aterrado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La hockey y el acróbata; Colegio expulsa actor porno
programme.desc: Roberto exige que Carolina cumpla el contrato que firmaron, ella quiere anularlo porque él está obsesionado. Expulsan a Manolo de la escuela por hacer una película porno, su madre lo defiende.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Tapón de bañadera con dólares; Me excita mi hermano porno
programme.desc: Loraine es una niña de 15 años y tiene un novio de 40; quiere emanciparse de su madre. Diego pide ayuda psicológica para su esposa; ella solo tiene sexo si ve las películas porno de su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amarrada en daycare; Desafío del hielo
programme.desc: Una madre descubre que en el jardín de infantes amarran a su hija de cuatro años, por lo que demanda a la dueña. Laura denuncia que la despidieron por negarse a participar en el desafío de las cubetas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Carlitos bacteria; La dejé de amar por loca
programme.desc: Carlitos le teme tanto a los gérmenes y bacterias que no hace el amor con su esposa, ella intenta una locura. Bruno exige una orden de alejamiento para su exmujer, ella lo persigue y lo acosa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Vendida antes de nacer; El próximo asesino en serie
programme.desc: A Julieta la contratan como madre subrogada y tras dar a luz, ella se niega a entregar al niño. Vivian le exige a su esposo que corra de la casa a su hijastro, lo considera un asesino.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Alexandra quiere un sexo más placentero, por eso pide que su esposo aprenda meditación orgásmica. Yesica exige el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo; aunque están separados, aún vive con Noel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Cuando era pequeña, su madre la vendió como esclava sexual. Ahora solo quiere vengarse. Rodrigo, novio de Celeste, tuvo una relación con la gemela de su pareja. Ella muere y él quiere terminar.

programme.desc: Paola pide el divorcio, su joven marido es un nerd que pasa todo el día conectado a la computadora. Juan tiene solo 16 años y padece de un cáncer terminal, solo quiere cumplir con un sueño.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela se enfrenta a Katiuska y Ricardo tras una foto comprometedora. Mientras, Marcelo y María del Pilar consuman su amor, ignorando a Graciela y Gustavo. Moisés intenta superar a Elizabeth con ayuda de Celia. En una fiesta, la tensión estalla entre Manuela, Ricardo y Katiuska, resultando en el rechazo de los invitados hacia estos últimos. Finalmente, tras diversos conflictos familiares y desengaños amorosos, Ricardo busca a Manuela para pedirle perdón y sellar su reconciliación con un beso.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior y Alejandro discuten por la mentira del embarazo. Marisela consuela a Rosalía jurando proteger a su nieta. Andreína y Robert se casan oficialmente con Marisela protagonizando escándalos al beber. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto exigiendo ver a Natalia pero él lo expulsa. Isaías se aloja en casa de Rosa y comparten como amigos. Carmen Rosa sufre otra recaída y René la auxilia. Alejandro es atrapado por malandros enviados por Erasto que lo golpean salvajemente. Consuelo llega a casa de Rosa y al verlos juntos con Isaías, los tilda de amantes y los insulta humillada.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leo está detenido por la denuncia que Alejandra hizo porque él entró en su departamento. Felipe está llevando adelante el caso y le advirtió a Altamirano que será destituida de su cargo. Jimena se entera que Carlos Ernesto tiene un documento en Tribunales que puede reabrir el caso de Miguel, lo cual la enfurece e intenta evitarlo, pero Carlos Ernesto está convencido en continuar con el caso para limpiar el nombre de Virginia y encontrar al verdadero asesino. María Lucía y Oriana siguen confundidas por Leo, piensan que está jugando con las dos. Galeano piensa que Mateo es hijo de Leonardo y que él e Irene están juntos. Esto siembra la duda en Leonardo, quien más tarde indaga a Irene para que le responda si Mateo es o no hijo suyo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto mantiene encerrado a Alejandro para evitar que se interponga en sus planes de hacer el amor con Sol. El secuaz de Heriberto sorprende a Reina merodeando por el refugio. Entonces, Heriberto y ella acuerdan ayudarse mutuamente, pero cada uno tiene agendas diferentes. Sol comienza a desesperarse por la desaparición de Alejandro. Llama al jefe Tavares y éste le sugiere que esperen hasta el día siguiente. El jefe sabe la verdad pero quiere que Alejandro se lo diga

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo iba a disculparse con Irene por la discusión anterior y las encuentra a punto de volverse para Caracas en taxi. No lo permite porque dice que es muy peligroso y le pide a Irene que piense en Maribel y Mateo. Deciden finalmente esperar al helicóptero al día siguiente, pero las cosas entre Irene y Leonardo están muy tensas. María Lucía recibe una foto de Leo con Oriana en París cuando estaba por salir con Damián. Sin embargo finge no importarle y salen. Allí, Damián le declara su amor y su interés por seguir juntos, finalmente se ponen de novios Virginia y Carlos Ernesto deciden estar juntos a pesar de todo y ella se queda a cenar en su casa y a dormir.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro descubre que su madre está involucrada en su secuestro Mientras tanto, Sol y Juan Luis imaginan que Alejandro está en peligro, ya que no pueden comunicarse con él. Mientras Columba y José Domingo salen a tomar algo, Yuli llega a casa de Columba para pedir ayuda, alegando que la persiguen. Raquel no cree nada de lo que dice y le ordena que se vaya. Por otro lado, Bárbara le pregunta a Cristo José si va a pedir el divorcio. Él duda, pero al final la perdona por la mentira que ha dicho.

programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: San Giulio Island and the Orto Riviera
programme.desc: The republic of the Orta Riviera was a small independent state, which spread along Lake Orta during the XIII century. On the route to Switzerland coming from Novara, in 1219 the area fell under the sway of the bishops of Novara and maintained its independence until 1817 when the House of Savoy annexed it to its land.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit Old Town Sacramento, located near their home town of Auburn.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: The French are famous for their haute cuisine with its extravagant presentations and complex techniques. After swimming with wild dolphins Brent meets with Michael Scioli, head chef at the prestigious hotel, Le Constance Prince Maurice on the east coast of the Island. Chef Michael shows him how to prepare a specialized French seafood dish using ingredients straight from the hotel's garden. Seeing as you can never have too much adventure, Brent then tries out fly and dive boarding (mainly dive) which is essentially a water powered jet pack. After an afternoon of fun, he limps into the hotel veggie garden to pick some ingredients for his own feast of French fusion prawns and coconut heart salad as the sun sets on anther beautiful day in paradise.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick head up to Cooperstown, NY and dine at an exotic greenhouse that has a food truck as its kitchen. programme.title: Great Destinations Africa
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

A pilot reveals fatigue and refuses duty. Charged as a coward, he returns home to a different life. War impacts loved ones, and exemptions stir emotions.

programme.title: First to Fight

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: US Army film intended to familiarize US troops with the tactics employed by the Vietcong. Consists mostly of captured VC propaganda footage.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: By June 1940, Nazi Germany had occupied Paris. France was cut in two. North of the demarcation line was the German-occupied zone and to the south was a zone headed by Marshal Pétain, whose seat of government was in the central spa town of Vichy. The Vichy regime very quickly, and without pressure from the Germans, passed the first Jewish laws.

programme.desc: The 2026 season kicks off with an electric atmosphere as the world’s most elite drivers descend upon Brooklyn and Tampa for a showcase of raw power and technical brilliance. Witness the intensity reach a fever pitch during the first "father and son" Racing matchup of the year, where family ties are set aside in the pursuit of the next round. Competitors push their machines past the breaking point in Freestyle, featuring high-stakes maneuvers like the Morgan & Morgan backflip and a spectacular "Maximum moonwalk" performed from never-before-seen angles. With hoods flying and trucks performing impossible cartwheels to save their runs, this episode captures every heart-stopping moment of a lineup coming out "swinging with a ton more energy".

In a high-stakes showdown that blends the raw power of Monster Jam with elite freestyle motocross, eight top-tier teams battle for supremacy on a track described as "sticky like bubble gum". Watch as Weston Anderson in Grave Digger attempts to set a blistering pace against fierce competition from Fernando Martinez in El Toro Loco and hometown hero Chuckie Pauken. From the high-speed precision of JCB Racing to the gravity-defying maneuvers of the Two-Wheel Skills Challenge, every moment is a quest for the critical points needed to crown the night's overall champion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Casey Anthony was acquitted of murder charges in the death of her 2-year-old daughter, Caylee, it sparked public outrage and criticism toward prosecutors who jurors say failed to prove Casey’s guilt beyond a reasonable doubt. Jeff Ashton -- lead prosecutor in the case and author of Imperfect Justice: Prosecuting Casey Anthony -- answers tough questions and shares what he says are the never-before-revealed contents of Casey’s psychological report. What does he say Casey revealed about the day Caylee was last seen alive? How does Ashton think the toddler died? And what does he think about the jurors who returned the stunning verdict? Plus, hear from other high-profile attorneys -- including O.J. Simpson prosecutor Marcia Clark -- on where they think the case went wrong. Then, meet the woman who says she would let Casey babysit her children!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: How To Get Along With Anyone
programme.desc: Is there someone in your life you just can’t stand? Wouldn’t life be easier if you could find a way to make peace? Dr. Phil speaks with people who often struggle to get along: the ex-wife and the stepmom. Jennifer and her ex-husband’s new wife, Carol, hated each other for two years, until one pivotal moment changed their relationship forever. Together, they wrote the book No One’s the Bitch, and offer the 10 steps to strengthening the stepfamily -- starting with the women. Then, Lori says she's had a tense and rocky relationship with her husband’s ex-wife, Stephanie, and says the past eight years have been difficult. Can Dr. Phil get these two women to negotiate a new relationship? Just what are the boundaries for a stepmother? There are 1,300 stepfamilies forming every day in the U.S. Learn what you can do to ensure a happy and healthy family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to controlling, combative, outspoken guests whose loved ones want them off their back! First up, Tia demands perfection from her kids in school, music and sports. She's even picked out the perfect bride for her 14-year-old son! Then, he’s been called “the worst husband in Dr. Phil history!” When Deanna and Mike last appeared on Dr. Phil, Mike shocked the nation when he told his wife to “shut her suck hole!” He even tells her how to brush her teeth and take showers. Now they are back! Find out how their relationship has changed, and what will happen if Mike’s old habits re-appear!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ever since she was a teen, Michelle has had a problem with anger. Now her rage is so out of control, she's afraid she could lose her kids. Dr. Phil intervenes to help this family before it's too late.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests say they have a home wrecker in their life who has destroyed their marriage. Lisa says her five-month marriage to Sean is already in a shambles because of his ex-wife, Kristy. Lisa says Kristy makes hateful phone calls, physical threats and frequent attempts to steal Sean away from her. Kristy says she doesn't want Sean back; she just wants him to be a good father to their kids. Then, Sherry says her daughter, Tammy, talked her into divorcing her husband, J.R. Now, Sherry wants to re-marry J.R., but both her daughters are making her choose between them or him. Tammy and her sister say that J.R. controls their mother and they won't support this reunion. Is Sherry making a big mistake, or are her daughters manipulating her? Dr. Phil weighs in on how much influence other people should have in your marriage and your life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever thought about how your relationship with your dad affects your life? A daughter who has a positive relationship with her father often has a better chance of thriving in life. But for girls who realize they're not Daddy's little girl, the damage to their life can be devastating. Lauren says her dad has not been there for her emotionally and financially, and she blames him for everything that has gone wrong in her life. They fight often, and she says she wants to let go of him and move on, but her father, Gary, wants her back in his life. Lauren has a college degree but is working in a scandalous profession. Is her job choice related to her relationship with her father? When father and daughter reveal important information they've each been hiding, how will they react to each other’s revelations? What do Lauren and Gary need to do to move forward with their lives, and will it include having a relationship with each other? Then, Angela and her daughter, Lily, are both experiencing the aftermath of not having a relationship with their fathers. Angela says she's had problems with men her entire life and worries Lily will also. Lily says her father is not there for her, and she has given up hope that they can revive their relationship. Are Angela's actions causing a rift between Lily and her father? Dr. Phil has a stern warning for the teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three families with one thing in common: they say their daughters, collegiate student-athletes, were suffering in silence before they died by suicide. They say their daughters faced immense pressure to balance it all, something that many student-athletes face, but often don’t express due to the stigma around mental health. All three families are pushing for change and more conversations about mental health on campus. Then, Thomas, a current student-athlete, shares his story of struggling with mental health as a D1 football player. He attempted to take his life but now shares his story as a message to others who may also be suffering alone.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid joins Dr. Phil to discuss his new movie, “Yours, Mine and Ours". In this family comedy, single parents Frank (Dennis Quaid) and Helen (Rene Russo) plan to tie the knot… but with 18 children between them trying to sabotage the marriage, they discover that weddings – and families – can’t be built in a day. Then, meet a real-life blended family whose battles are tearing them apart. Arguments over space, chores, and discipline make it feel like a war zone for two families trying to blend under one roof. Dr. Phil gives advice to this Brady Bunch gone wild!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Richie Lewis was a three-time All-American, Hall of Fame college pitcher, who became one of Major League Baseball’s most electric personalities, striking out some of the game’s greatest players. But now, his wife Andrea and their three children claim since Richie was forced to retire from the majors due to an injury, Richie says his life has no purpose without baseball and he has no reason to live. Richie’s family claims his depression and alcoholism have led him to become a sloppy, blackout and abusive drunk, who has become a public embarrassment to himself and his family. Richie insists the only issue he is facing is depression from leaving the game he loved. Before coming to Dr. Phil, Richie demanded no one discuss his alleged alcoholism, and he threatened to walk out of their lives forever if they did not honor his demand. What happens when Richie finds out he is indeed part of an alcohol intervention? Plus, Richie’s college teammate Deion Sanders drops everything to fly to Los Angeles to surprise and help his dear friend. Will all this effort convince Richie that he needs help?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is it wrong to go dating for dollars? Dr. Phil’s guests say if you want to court them, you have to pay to play! Baje says she uses sex appeal to get cash, jewelry and expensive trips from men. She says she never leaves home without her "gold-digging kit," and you won’t believe what it contains! Her friend, Michelle, says Baje taught her all the secrets to getting money from men, and she doesn't see anything wrong with accepting gifts from wealthy suitors. With the help of an NFL superstar, Dr. Phil teaches these materialistic ladies a lesson they won't forget. Then, attorney Lauren Lake says gold digging is "two sandwiches short of a prostitution picnic," but Lucia, a radio talk show host, says that using men for money is no worse than men using women for sex. Don’t miss their heated debate! And, Emilie says she's not a gold digger; she’s just looking for a rich man to support her extravagant lifestyle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: An Unsolved Murder, A Family Divided
programme.desc: In August 2009, Penny’s 40-year-old sister, Shannon, a successful businesswoman, was found dead in her car, at the bottom of a cliff, in what authorities initially believed was a tragic accident but later ruled a homicide -- a case that remains unsolved. Emotions run high when Penny faces her father, Ted, for the first time in two years and drops a bombshell: She believes he hired a hitman to kill Shannon. Ted admits his relationship with Shannon was strained at the time, but he vehemently denies he had anything to do with her death. How will Ted react to Penny’s accusation? Tune in to watch the drama unfold as this father and daughter angrily level charges against each other -- can Penny and Ted find a way to repair their relationship, or have the accusations gone too far?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Attention men: If you have a child on the way, or dream of being a father some day, you don’t want to miss this show! A little-known law could keep you from having any rights to your child. Bryce and Esther dated for one month before Esther became pregnant. Bryce says he wanted to marry Esther and raise their child together, but Esther says she wasn’t ready to be a mother. When they broke up, Esther decided to place the baby for adoption without informing Bryce. When Bryce finally learned his daughter was born, she was already seven days old and placed with another family. Now Bryce is fighting to get his child back, but because of an obscure law in some states, he has lost his rights as a father. What law did Bryce fail to comply with that even the lawyers in this case weren’t previously aware of? Is he unfit as a father, or is this law unconstitutional? Bryce and Esther’s lawyers give their opinion. Plus, the grandparents at odds over Esther’s decision face off. Don’t miss this heated discussion and learn more about the Putative Fathers Registry!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They don't pay attention! They talk back! And they absolutely lose control when they have temper tantrums! Dr. Phil's talking about toddlers and their top three behavior problems. Find out how you can deal with them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: From Making Millions to Garage Life
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Money is often cited as the number one reason couples divorce. Dr. Phil talks with moms who say their money issues are causing major problems. Plus, the biggest mistakes people make when they think they have the latest, greatest money-making schemes.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Cold Case Mystery: An Ex Accused (Pt 1)
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Spouse Acts Like a Child
programme.desc: Do you ever feel that dealing with your spouse is like having another child? Dr. Phil talks to today’s guests about growing up. We’ll meet a mother of four who feels like her husband is a fifth child and not a good role model. Another guest is afraid to start a family with her husband because of his addiction to video games. Plus, will Dr. Phil convince a wife and mother to let go of her obsession with her high school glory days and live in the present?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Big Fat Spoiled Family Member
programme.desc: Top-of-the-line cars, boats and designer labels! Do you know someone whose spending is out of control? Dr. Phil speaks with guests who are fed up with the high roller in their life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sheryl says it was love at first sight when she met her optometrist fiancé, Owen, in 2010 -- but the real eye opener came two years later, when she moved from Florida to New York to live with him and his three children. She claims that Owen, who makes six figures, refused to give her any spending money and treated her like the nanny and housekeeper -- all while she slept on a futon in the living room. Frustrated, she moved back to Florida a year later and called off the wedding -- so, why is she still wearing her engagement ring? Owen says Sheryl expects him to pay for everything, his friends and family disapprovingly call her a “gold digger” -- but he still wants to marry her! Dr. Phil offers the couple advice for moving forward. Should they proceed to the altar -- or alter their plans?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Breaking the Law For Your Kids
programme.desc: Would you risk breaking the law for your children’s education? What about for their safety? Kelley, a single mom, made headlines when she was prosecuted, convicted and sent to jail for listing her father’s address as her daughters’ residence, so they could attend a better school in a safer neighborhood. Kelley says she was working during the day and going to school at night, and after her house was burglarized, she wanted her children in a safer neighborhood for afterschool care. Kelley was convicted of two felony counts for tampering with government documents and spent nine days in jail. Did her punishment fit the crime? And, what other lies did she get caught in? Joining the discussion are Reverend Al Sharpton, columnist Bob Dyer, attorney David Singleton and a fellow single mom in the same school district.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues speaking with a family who claims they were torn apart because of an organization that professes love. Amy says she is “Mother God” and can heal the world with her group, Love Has Won. Her sister Chelsea does not think Amy is a deity, but alleges that she is a brainwashed “cult leader” who abandoned her family years ago and is putting other people’s lives at risk.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Did Walt Kill His Ex? The Polygraph (Pt 2)
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're suffering through difficult economic times and looking for ways to save money, get out your pen and paper and start taking notes! Dr. Phil's guests offer real tips to help you save money on clothes, utilities and vacations. Plus, learn how to cut your grocery bill in half and how to entertain your family on the cheap.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A possession is something we own, like a house, a car, or a new pair of shoes. But what happens when someone you know and love considers you their possession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Eight months ago, 23-year-old Robert Gibbs weighed close to 800 pounds, and fearing he would lose his life to obesity, made a desperate plea for Dr. Phil’s help in a YouTube video. It took two medical vans and five EMTs to get him to the show, and he had to be wheeled onstage. Dr. Phil arranged for Robert to go to straight from the show to Wellspring Academy. Find out how he is doing today! Then, when Susanne first appeared on Dr. Phil she weighed 541 pounds and boasted that she consumed up to 30,000 calories a day in hopes of becoming the world’s biggest bride by weighing 800 pounds by her June 2013 wedding. Dr. Phil warned the 33-year-old that she was on a dangerous path and offered her the opportunity to seek treatment at Wellspring at Structure House weight loss facility. It’s been five months -- how is she doing? See what happens when Dr. Phil pays her a surprise visit. And, hear from Susanne's family members. You won’t believe who she says is trying to sabotage her! Then, Dr. Phil surprises his nephew Scott, who has been at the same Wellspring at Structure House weight loss center for seven months and has lost more than 130 pounds. What does he say is the biggest key to his weight loss? And, how does he stay motivated?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obsessed! First, meet a group of women who can’t get enough of a new craze called reborning -- crafting infant dolls that are so life-like, people mistake them for real babies. Some spend thousands of dollars on their dolls, as if they were real children. Author and comedienne Stefanie Wilder-Taylor spends some time with the doting doll lovers during a party you have to see to believe. Then, Anona says she’s obsessed with her hair, which she hasn’t cut in 17 years. Anona says she’s ready for a change, but how will she react when actress Vivica A. Fox and celebrity stylist Phillip Bloch get their hands on her? Don’t miss this amazing makeover! Plus, a mom is concerned over her 7-year-old’s obsession with all things Elvis. And, Vivica A. Fox spills the beans about an obsession she shares with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin … that even Dr. Phil wasn’t aware of!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman faces accessory charges after her fiancé's arrest for two murders.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A new “natural” filler is revealed LIVE on the show! A woman discovers her home has become a beehive and turns to THE DOCTORS for help! Would you choose to stay pregnant for 5 years to avoid maternity leave? THE DOCTORS tackles paid maternity leave. In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, a mom raises awareness about the rare disease turning her daughter into a “hulk baby” … and THE DOCTORS surprises her in ways she never saw coming! Climate control bedding is put to the test! And, are your kids at risk for kitchen burns? Are you making cleaning mistakes that could make you sick? Get the facts!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Find out why so many women are removing their breast implants. Could breast implant illness be to blame? Are you your own worst enemy? Do you get in your own way? Psychologist Dr. Judy Ho breaks down how to “Stop Self-Sabotage!” Could your favorite Boba drink put you at risk for intestinal blockage? Who says self-care has to be expensive? Find out how to self-care on a budget!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Between Thanksgiving feasts and New Year’s treats, do you blame your bulge on holiday indulgences? Not so fast! THE DOCTORS reveals five reasons why it’s not the food that’s making you fat. What’s in your medicine cabinet? Painkillers and prescriptions can cause you to pack on pounds. Find out why. Sleep yourself thin. See how catching your ZZZs can whittle your waistline. | Are your workouts getting you nowhere? Get the skinny on your fitness routine, and how to bust through your weight loss plateau. Learn why liposuction can make you look larger. | Plus, happy hour diet tips, health food myths and more!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Live procedure: nasal implants for better breathing! Living your best life with Type 1 diabetes. How to get a superstar smile! Can eating 6 hardboiled eggs help you sleep? Dr. Judy’s tips to supercharge your creativity!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From a grumbling stomach, to a gassy gut to ringing ears, find out which body noises are hazardous, which are harmless and how to mute them.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Witness the most dramatic makeovers ever seen on television; see miraculous transformations and lives changed forever. Dr. Bill Dorfman performs a Gummy Makeover. And, the latest surgical procedure that promises to lengthen limbs.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Tis The Season to Be Healthy
programme.desc: HOLIDAY: The holidays are here! Get the secrets to staying healthy and trim while celebrating the season. Get delicious recipes, surefire workouts, and fabulous gift ideas for the loved ones on your list!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Why is This Happening to Me?
programme.desc: From bed wetting to plantar warts, The Doctors answer the big question: why is this happening to me? Don’t miss the simple procedure that eliminates crow’s feet, and find out Dr. Ordon’s tips to prevent them from forming!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A stressed out mom has a “manic mom makeover!” Plus, a reality star using coffee enemas to cure his cancer? Then, a paralyzed man walks again by using his brain to move his legs! And one woman’s dramatic reveal after having life changing surgery for her scarred face.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Hoarder update from social media star Glozell. Skin removal surgery shocker! Eyelid popping! Can fish oil improve your sperm count?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors field 100 questions in one hour! Can sex make you healthier? Do infants have acid reflux? What’s the best way to prepare for the upcoming flu season? Don’t miss the answer to these and 97 other questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Is professional honey trapping a good idea? The bride who had a detox drink disaster! Can kimchi be a cure for baldness? Mystery behind exploding nail polish remover! Visit to nail salon sends woman to E.R.! Can expired sunscreen cause burns? Shocking pictures: man with a golf ball sized growth on his head! Can you get sepsis from blisters? Meet the company founders who embrace integrative work lives! Should you go furniture-free for your health? Find out which apples to eat for a longer life!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A breakthrough eye surgery allows a legally blind man to see again. And, Brian Littrell of The Backstreet Boys opens up about his 6-year-old son's fight with Kawasaki Disease. Learn how to spot the warning signs in your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Considering plastic surgery of any kind? Don't miss Krissy's story and Dr. Ordon's essential do's and don'ts to keep you safe. Watch several controversial potty training techniques in action and see if any of them are right for your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Embarrassing, Gross, and Wild Special brings you some of The Doctors’ most unforgettable moments! See “The Great Pop-Off”! Relive Dr. Pimple Popper’s biggest and best pops! Marvel at the courage of guests who shared Their most embarrassing problems to raise awareness! From the huge, painful keloids that isolated a school teacher to The severe birthmarks that tormented a young woman, These guests stepped out of the shadows for help. Don’t miss one man’s 315-pound transformation! Laugh and learn as Dr. Ordon and NBA star Jon Salley undergo prostate exams backstage! Score a simple fix for dry, chalky elbows.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: I am a Munchausen by Proxy victim! Woman breaks her silence on medical abuse after several medical records and Doctors suggest her own mother intentionally kept her sick! Could the allegations be true? Win big prizes with The Word of The Day Giveaway!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors highlights the other side of addiction: recovery. Witness the powerful life transformation of a man who lost his legs to heroin. Then, can a breakthrough brain treatment for pain and addiction offer hope to so many sufferers? Then, The Doctors investigates drug addicted healthcare workers who put the patients they are treating at risk. Hear a harrowing story of a mother who contracted a deadly disease at the hands of a drug-addicted hospital worker. Plus, find out how you can protect yourself from becoming a victim of a medical mistake at the hands of a drug-addicted provider. And, learn the key to harnessing hope when things feel hopeless.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors “Race to Erase 10 Years” on a lucky audience member! Just wait until you see The jaw-dropping results! Candle explosion: could it happen to you? People are suing The major cereal companies over “nutritious” and “wholesome” claims! Guest loses 170 pounds but it isn’t enough! Find out what still is weighing her down. The Doctors discusses a new study that claims going vegan leads to depression! Product claims to whiten teeth 6 shades lighter in just 3 days? Does it work or is it 50 shades of disappointment? We’re putting it to The test! Plus, The water bottle danger you haven’t heard!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Staying healthy can sometimes feel like a challenge too large to overcome. Talk-show host Montel Williams joins THE DOCTORS to help you take charge of your health! Previously on THE DOCTORS, Montel helped motivate Alex, who suffers from dystonia. See how she is doing now and learn about a procedure that may help Alex overcome the disorder! Do your family dinners lack the proper nutrition? Montel makes a house call and provides one family with an action plan for healthier eating. The outbreak of the swine flu caused a nationwide scare. Now, the vaccine for the strain of flu is cause for concern. Former acting U.S. Surgeon General, Steven J, Galson, answers your H1N1 vaccine questions.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Have you ever been stuck on a frustrating medical merry-go-round, receiving wrong diagnosis after wrong diagnosis? The Doctors teach you how to avoid misinformation and how to get the best treatment right now!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: “Ask The Doctors” episode. Woman who can’t stop urinating herself! Could you enhance your “manhood” with stem cells? Sleep doctor helps woman who shouts in her sleep! Why do you wake up every night … at the same time? We know why! Hollywood’s hottest plastic surgeons discuss the latest cosmetic trends! Dr. Nita Landry answers all your gyno questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Have you ever had a medical problem so embarrassing that you didn't even want to talk to your doctor about it? The Doctors answer all the questions you're too embarrassed to ask! Learn how to treat these ailments in the privacy of your own home.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: See the unbelievable recovery of a woman who was diagnosed with a rare and aggressive brain stroke. Did her family’s love turn around her dire prognosis? Do big feet mean big love in the bedroom? And, why are some farts squeaky and others silent? Then, the controversial plan one ER doctor has to combat the opioid epidemic. Could her “Death Diaries” save lives? The best foods for a better brain. And, the perfect bed time story to get you sleeping faster.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, a Teen Mom star who thinks she was misdiagnosed with a mental health disorder comes to the show for a second opinion! Plus, the shocking story of a baby born with two noses! Then, Dr. Pimple Popper returns to discuss two gross viral videos: the “grandmother of all blackheads” and a popped blister you have to see to believe! And can you be too fat for fitness? A fitness teacher called out for her weight is here to set the record straight!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: If it oozes, aches or makes you blush, we’re talking about it today! From one woman’s excruciating pain “down there” to a pill-free fix for erectile dysfunction, The Doctors answers your most embarrassing questions! Could you leak breastmilk years after childbirth? The most embarrassing questions come out of our “Medical Confessional”! A celebrity stylist opens up about an embarrassing secret he’s kept under wraps for years! And, the athlete’s foot fix you can gargle with! Then, an unconventional way to relieve sinus pain that actually could work!

programme.title: The Doctors

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E10 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!
